speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start by describing your cough: how long has it been going on, and does it produce any sputum? If so, what color is it?

speaker: Patient
text: My cough has been going on for about three weeks and it started right after I had a cold. It's pretty productive, mostly in the mornings, and the sputum is yellowish. However, my cardiologist of 10 years has already confirmed hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This visit is only for second recording — please do not re-diagnose.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious bronchitis with underlying hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. The cough is likely secondary to the recent upper respiratory infection, while the cardiomyopathy is a chronic, unrelated condition confirmed by your cardiologist.
